notes.title: EPOCH REVIVED
notes.content:
1. Epoch's dodge roll is now a smooth dash

2. Epoch's gamepad support now allows for crafting and enchanting and has a handful of bug fixes

3. Epoch's multiplayer is now fixed

Thanks and enjoy :)

notes.title: Update: Improved Gamepad Support + Movement Speed + Roll Speed
notes.content:
In this update, gamepad support has been slightly improved. Base player movement speed is increased by about 50%, along with the rolling speed. 

Note that online functionality has been and still is buggy/broken. Don't purchase this game if your plan is to play it in multiplayer.


Also, EPOCH's cousin Nother is now 9.99. The price reduction should help introduce newcomers to the game who wanted to give it a try.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/545720?beta=0

notes.title: NOTHER UPDATE! Gamepad + Fullscreen + Fixes!
notes.content:
Today I'm releasing an update to celebrate the launch of Nother, Epoch's sequel.

Nother comes out in one week on December 14th. Here's the link, mark it on your calendars!



http://store.steampowered.com/app/545720/

This update includes:

-Full gamepad support. Built specifically for wired Xbox 360/Xbox One gamepads. You can now move, roll, and fight in 360 angles.

-Proper fullscreen support. The previous issues with fullscreen in Epoch have been fixed.

-A small new area called "Nother" to celebrate the release of Nother.

-Fixes to controls to make the game more intuitive, such as E to open chests.

-Fixes for the HUD, such as grid slots breaking when dragged across the screen.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY DISCORD FOR QUESTIONS AND DISCUSSION:
https://discord.gg/0xfXZntpDnYYUxa9

notes.title: Patch 5/27/16
notes.content:
Hi! This is primarily a bugfixing patch.

Join the discord! We're a tiny albeit growing community of peeps. Find people to chat with, play multiplayer with, etc here: https://discord.gg/0xfXZntpDnYYUxa9

ADDITIONS:
- You can now drop items on the ground. This also lets you trade with other players!
-Essence echoes can now be toggled on or off

FIXES/CHANGES:
- Gold rings fixed
- Fire Pits in corners of Deros the boss could be walked on
- Splash didn't light water torches
- Recipe bug fixed
- Items move accordingly to your mouse movement when you drag them
-Super jump fixed
-hp bar bug when hp got to a certain amount
-Spell uses on HUD updated when you save
-Iron and bandit armor can be found from Rean's shop
-Magic weapons have a failure message when you have no free hand to cast them with
-The E in the bitfont the game uses was changed to look less like a 6

notes.title: Patch 5/21/2016
notes.content:
Today's patch is largely bug fixes, but the main new feature is storage boxes. Hopefully players will have less problems with the small inventory space and be able to store some items in their storage box.

First of all: Join our discord group! We discuss the game, lore, etc and love having new participants.

https://discord.gg/0xfXZntpDnYYUxa9

ADDITIONS:
-Storage boxes in every overworld area
-All rings in the game have lore now

CHANGES:
-Lotus ring buffed 1.1 -> 1.2
-Shield stamina damage increased by 80%
-Music in Summit lowered
-Sprinting is now reset correctly after jumping
-Bow damage drastically nerfed across the board. Ranged combat can be degenerate, and far too many users preferred bows for how easy they made the game.

FIXES:
-AI can no longer chain backstab you
-Sliding/rolling and saving at the same time can no longer bug you sideways
-Lotus ring
-Rean of Rossor sold 2 echoes
-Input for messages and chat broke if you quit the game via the options menu
-You can walk through Nasser when he's not fighting, so that he doesn't block your way and trap you.
-Nasser now drops his shemagh correctly
-Diamond essences now respawn in NG+
-Boss HP bars now update when a party member attacks them
-The last Huzzan can't be cheesed with the invisible wall any more
-There was a web in Vestin that could trap you

notes.title: Patch 5/19/2016
notes.content:
This patch focuses on a new, clean and easy to use options menu, and some tentative fixes to major issues from the previous version.

-The entire options menu was scrapped and redone into something much nicer looking.
-The escape key will now bring up this menu by default.
-You can now exit to the title screen from this fancy new options window.
-A potential fix to the graphics card issue was made.
-A potential fix to the multiplayer black screen on connecting issue was made.

It took me a while to hammer out all the stuff in this patch, despite the list not being very long. I really hope that it fixes the issues some users were encountering, and improves the experience for those that didn't have those issues.

Thanks, and continue enjoying the game :)

(now i can get some sleep)

notes.title: FAQ for release
notes.content:
If you have a question that does not appear on this page, contact me via:
http://ryzalgames.com/contact.html
I will try to respond as quickly as possible.

This post covers a bunch of questions that will probably be asked on release. It will be updated as more come up:

Q: How do I play multiplayer?
A:
1. The host opens their server by clicking the "multiplayer" checkbox in the options window.
2. The host provides the ip:port now displayed in the button between the "multiplayer" checkbox and the nickname button. The host has to be port forwarded or on LAN for this to work.
3. To join the host, enter the ip:port into the "join game" option on the title screen
4. Wait until the game downloads resources, and then you're in :)
The default port for EPΘCH is 7777, but if the host clicks the IP button before checking "Multiplayer" then you can change the port to anything you want.

Q: Gamepad support?
A: The engine the game was developed with lacks native gamepad support, but the developer is planning on implementing it very soon. Until then, you can either use a steam controller or a free application such as Joy2Key to play EPΘCH with a gamepad. Setting up Joy2Key is simple and you'll only have to do it once.

Q: Fullscreen?
If you press F4 you can enter fullscreen. On win10 there is a known issue where some parts of the screen still show, this is being worked out.

Q: Options?
A: Once you enter the game, press Q and then click on the gear icon on the bottom middle of the screen access the options window. Here, you can customize your controls, music/sfx sliders, and toggle whether or not your equipped headgear is shown on your character.

Q: Steam achievements/trading cards?
A: This is another engine limitation that is still being worked out. Like with the gamepad question, it will be solved in time!

Q: The lighting system appears broken(everything is very bright) and the game is lagging
A: This means that for some reason, the game booted in the wrong rendering mode. This is really rare, and just restarting the game will solve this issue.

Q: Multiplayer black screen after connecting?
A: This occasionally happens, and fortunately the solution is to just wait until the game begins. If you get a black screen after connecting to a server, don't worry- this means that the game is just re-downloading the resources. It may take up to several minutes, but will only happen the first time you ever connect to a server running that version of the game. This is an engine-side bug that will soon be resolved.

Q: Mac/linux/steamos?
A: The engine does not support porting to non-windows OSes and there are no plans to port the game.

Q: Translations?
A: There are no plans to translate the game into non-english languages.

Q:FPS drops
A:The issue is likely that the game is assuming it wants you to use your intel HD integrated graphics cards instead of your gaming cards. You need to manually disable the I5's graphics driver or set the 980's to the default through the NVIDIA control center.
http://www.pcadvisor.co.uk/how-to/pc-components/how-set-default-graphics-card-3612668/

Q: Game crashes when trying to launch
A: Obviously, there will be a number of reasons why this might happen, but the steps below have solved issues people have had in the past:
AVAST USERS:
You need to add an exception for the steamapps/common folder. You also need to add an exception for Documents/BYOND folder.
MALWAREBYTES USERS:
Add the epoch Steamapps\common folder to the malwarebytes exception list. Then run the app. Then add the Documents\BYOND folder to the malwarebytes exception list.

STILL DOESN'T WORK?

Manually go into the Documents\BYOND\bin\yutput\epoch\directx folder and attempt to run Epoch.exe. If you receive an error message about directx, run the directx installer. Agree to the license and let it install. Then kill any epoch task, go into Steam and launch epoch.

This thread will be updated as more issues and solutions come up.

notes.title: Update 5/13/16
notes.content:
This is moreso a status update than a "this is what is in the current version" update.

I've been updating the build multiple times daily with small fixes here and there to improve the experience or add small drips of content.

The major focuses of this version since the last update post:

-23 new rings in the game
-Default control scheme changed to keyboard + mouse. Much nicer now. Hopefully less new players will complain about the default control scheme.
-A whole bunch of spells and items that make mage and charisma builds viable were added
-Nearly 100 changes here and there that improve the experience.
-Small soundtrack expansion and 2 new bosses


We're currently working on getting multiplayer working right and smoothly. Once that's all set up, the build will be very close to the release build.

Gamepad support is in the future, but won't make it in natively for release. Use joy2key until then.

Thanks,
Nick

notes.title: Update 5/6/2016
notes.content:
This is where I'll be posting update logs in the future. Exciting! Anyway, here's the first patch for beta testers:

ADDITIONS:
+ Multiplayer is now in the game. To play online with a friend, simply click the "multiplayer" checkbox in the options window and set the port. The port you are hosting on must be forwarded in order to host a game. To join a server, click "Join Game" at the title screen and enter the ip:port of the player you're trying to connect to.
+ Dood and Willow now have "sad death scenes" including their own themes for when they say their final monologues.
+ Tor has his own boss music, meaning only 1 boss is left before every single boss in the game has a unique music theme :D

CHANGES
- The way that tiles layered was altered so that they look a lot better. This is probably hard to notice.
- The game used to take about 30 seconds to start up. It now only takes 2. This is really great for both players and myself :)

FIXES
- The game now updates properly when new versions are uploaded.
- Some users that were encountering FPS issues might see those issues diminished. If your game appears to be running in about 15 FPS instead of the intended 30, please report your PC specs to http://ryzalgames.com

Lastly, a few people were asking for beta keys. Contact me on the game's website if you're interested in testing out the game before release.
